description.value: Canlan Ice Sports North Shore is an indoor ice skating facility in North Vancouver, part of the Canlan Ice Sports network of recreational ice complexes across Canada. Tagged as a public building in OSM, it serves recreational skaters and hockey players in the North Shore area. A touring cyclist passing through North Vancouver may find it a notable stop or landmark in the community.
